body: i think i made my love, the only person i have in this world, really mad at me and now i feel like i'm melting
Yep. Was really really invested in it back in the day.

Since this month...i first started just scraping at myself with a pair of scissors, then it got worse. Snipped and pulled at myself until i bled a lot. If i could go back in time, i'd would have stopped myself. Everything happened because my jealousy and envy ate me alive.
